thesis: What left still occupies the room until you leave the gap named.
monologue: I don't leave the light on for a ghost. I don't stack the boxes like a shrine. I don't count the hangers that stay spaced. I don't wait for the train that never comes. I don't turn the key that opens nothing. I don't walk the path that loops for two. I don't toast the mug that holds no heat. I don't keep the rod with the lone hanger. I let the tide take the name and go.
